editorial.blurb: Cobblestone Cafe & Bistro shines with excellent dinner service, creative brunch dishes, and a cozy atmosphere where classics like Surf and Turf and Schnitzel & Waffles truly shine.
editorial.insiderTip: Come for dinner rather than brunch—reviewers rave about the dinner experience and note brunch service can be slow; the Surf and Turf is worth planning ahead for.

topDishes.note: Excellent brunch standout, cooked to perfection
